ios.desc:
Think about what you buy actually costs you. Your time.

Based on how long you think you will live, Grim Widget will show you how many days you have left to live and calculates the true cost of purchases in days of your life.

  FEATURES:
  • Life countdown widget for your home screen
  • See days lived vs days remaining
  • Financial calculator: "This $1600 laptop costs me 2 days of life"*
  • Shows percentage of remaining time each purchase costs
  • All data stays private on your device
  • Beautiful, minimalist design
  • Works on iPhone and iPad

 HOW IT WORKS:
  Enter your birth date, expected lifespan, and yearly salary. The app calculates your hourly value and shows you exactly what every purchase costs in life energy.

  That $5 coffee? 6 minutes of your life.
  That $50,000 car? 3 months of your remaining time.
  That $500,000 house? 2.5 years of your existence.

 WIDGET ON YOUR HOME SCREEN:
  Your mortality countdown lives right on your iPhone. Every glance reminds you: time is finite, spend it wisely.

 PRIVACY FIRST:
  All your personal data stays on your device. No tracking, no ads, no data collection. Your mortality is your business.

 MINDFUL SPENDING:
  Stop impulse purchases. Start asking: "Is this worth X days of my life?" Most of the time, the answer is no.

  Perfect for minimalists, financial consciousness, and mortality awareness. The most honest financial app you'll ever use.

  Stop spending money mindlessly. Start spending life intentionally.

*Does not include the impact of Federal, state, and local taxes.
